svg.title: brocket
svg.desc: The brocket stag as the guardian deity of a forest edge at night, its spike antlers etched with glowing circuit traces and a twelve-hour dial behind its head, standing on a ledge carved with a terminal prompt. Around it attend an engraved stele that remembers and aims, an anvil that authors, and a crucible that audits, below a sky holding a version-history constellation and a nearest-neighbour star cluster, with server spires on the far ridge.
svg.text: Terminal tasks that hold at the edge of frontier capability, where difficulty is measured and never claimed.
